            s=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(m(p)-dA_dt,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3), p0, max_nfev=3000)

        except Exception: pass
    print(name, np.mean(best.fun**2)/V, np.round(best.x,4))
